profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | Azure Developer
profile.summary: I am a Microsoft Certified Professional C# Specialist, certified Azure Developer Associate, .NET developer and a license Electronics and Communications Engineer (PH). I have experience on architecture and development of different technologies and how to bring them together into a distributed(microservices), usable, scalable, maintainable and efficient system in an agile environment.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Microsoft Azure · Azure Cosmos DB · Microservices · Software as a Service (SaaS) · C# · Cloud-Native Architecture · Cloud Application Development · DevOps · .NET Core · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.locationName: Baguio City, Cordillera Admin Region, Philippines

positions.title: President/CEO/.NET Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed a All-in-One Prepaid Topup Loading Platform for mobile subscribers in the Philippines (www.ebizupnorth.com) utilizing MSMQ, SQL, SOAP/REST web services, WCF, Windows Form, SIM Toolkit and C#
•	Integrated Facebook Messenger to be used for transaction requests
•	Developed a library for sending/receiving SMS messages and SIM Toolkit for GSM modem
•	Performed  IT integration
•	Managed business plans and strategies of the company
•	Performed hands on experience in Microsoft .Net Technologies, NET Framework 2.0/3.5/4.0/4.5, ASP.NET, LINQ, ASP.NET MVC, Entity Framework, Web Services 
•	Performed tasks related in MS SQL2000/2005/2008/2012, Database Design, Maintenance and T-SQL developer, IIS setup and configuration

positions.title: President/CEO/.NET Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed an International Voice Call Platform using Asterisk and .NET technology
•	Performed tasks related on Asterisk VOIP, SMS/text-based applications 
•	Acted as a consultant on Philippine Branch

positions.title: Manager & Co-Founder/ .NET Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed an Enrollment System for a Christian College 
•	Developed Billing System for Electric Cooperatives
•	Developed programs in C/C++/C# for students thesis
•	Developed customized software using Visual Studio and .NET Framework, ASP.NET/SQL2000/2005/T-SQL/VB.NET/C#, POS
•	Installed and configured LAN/VLAN 
•	Installed and configured Windows Server/IIS Servers
•	Installed and configured MS SQL Server

positions.title: Cadet Engineer
positions.description:
•	Conducted test on wire bonding parameters such as ball height, wire strength
•	Maintained and repaired wire bonding machines such as Shinkawa, K&S
•	Tested software on wire bonding machine

positions.title: Test Technician
positions.description:
•	Troubleshoot, repaired, and maintained semiconductor test equipment
•	Setup software on test equipments
